subject: PrivNet compatibility check & mitigation plan
messages:
From: Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: support@medigen.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent PrivNet agent disconnects after nightly rollout

Hi Irene,

We've started seeing intermittent connection drops between our edge agents and the PrivNet control plane since last night's partial rollout (canary -> 20%). Symptoms: frequent 502s from our side and agent reconnects every ~90s for a subset of hosts. I attached the agent diagnostic bundle (agent_diagnose.log) and a short screenshot of the agent status page.

Can you confirm whether Redwood performed any changes to the orchestrator or controlplane config last night? We need a timeline and immediate mitigation — this is impacting a small but production-critical cohort.

Thanks,
Jorge
Jorge Almeida
Head of Infrastructure, Medigen Health
jorge.almeida@medigen.com
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent PrivNet agent disconnects after nightly rollout

Hi Jorge — thanks for the report and logs. We did push a control-plane orchestrator change at 02:30 UTC intended to improve connection multiplexing; it was released to canary and then to a 20% cohort.

Immediate plan:
- Scheduling a bridgecall with our on-call infra engineer and your team at 10:30 PT to correlate logs and confirm impact windows.
- We'll pause further rollout to the remaining hosts until we confirm root cause.
- As a short-term mitigation, we can flip those affected hosts to the previous runtime variant (no config change) to restore stability while we investigate.

Please confirm whether you want us to execute the rollback on the affected cohort now or wait until after the bridgecall.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent PrivNet agent disconnects after nightly rollout

Hi — I'm looking at the agent_diagnose.log you sent. Quick read: we're seeing repeated TCP FIN/ACK cycles and an uptick in TLS handshake renegotiations immediately after the orchestrator change. Hypothesis: the new orchestrator config introduced a keepalive/window setting mismatch that causes agents behind certain NATs to drop long-lived connections.

Proposed immediate actions (low risk):
1) Set keepalive_probe=3 and keepalive_time=90s on the orchestrator side for the affected cohort. Patch attached (orchestrator-config-diff.patch).
2) If that doesn't stabilize within 15–30 minutes, we will perform a targeted rollback of the orchestrator to last night's working manifest for the affected hosts only (no global rollback).

I can do 1) now — need your confirmation, Jorge. If we proceed we will monitor token-level telemetry and connection-stats and report back every 10 minutes.

- Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.kim@medigen.com, support@medigen.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent PrivNet agent disconnects after nightly rollout

Thanks Aditya — please proceed with the keepalive tweak now. Prefer minimal blast radius, so try the config on the 20% cohort and let us know the observability window you'd like us to hold. Also, if you end up rolling back we need an expected downtime window and any steps our on-call will need to run.

We also need a short set of artifacts for our audit team showing what changed and when (SOC2 evidence). Could you include the manifest diff and a short timeline after the fix?

— Jorge
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent PrivNet agent disconnects after nightly rollout

Jorge — follow-up from the mitigation work we executed this morning:
- 09:40 PT: applied keepalive_profile (keepalive_time=90s) to the 20% cohort.
- 09:55 PT: telemetry showed reduced handshake churn; we observed a 92% drop in reconnect events for the targeted hosts over the next 30 minutes.
- 10:40 PT: after monitoring, we performed a targeted rollback for the 8 affected nodes where anomalies persisted. Rollback manifest attached (rollback_manifest.yaml).

Outcomes:
- All affected hosts are back to steady-state by 11:05 PT.
- No data-plane degradation observed, requests continued to be served by fallback routings during node restarts.

Artifacts attached for your audit team: rollback_manifest.yaml, a short manifest diff, and a draft postmortem we will finalize with your input (postmortem_draft.docx). We will also open a Jira (INF-9823) to track the permanent fix (orchestrator setting validation).

Next steps:
- Propose a 30-minute postmortem sync with your infra team on Wednesday 10:00 PT to walk through root cause, long-term mitigations, and communication for any downstream teams.
- We will provide a finalized postmortem and SOC2-friendly evidence package within 48 hours.

Please let me know if the proposed time works and whether you want Redwood to coordinate the calendar invite.

Best,
Irene
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, Jorge Almeida <jorge.almeida@medigen.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrivNet compatibility check & mitigation plan

Quick internal note and customer-facing update:
- Confirmed: impacted hosts were rolled back and stabilised by 11:05 PT on 5 May.
- Finance will review a pro-rata credit for the customer for the incident window; I'll loop in billing separately.
- Irena/Aditya/Mina: please finalize the postmortem draft and the SOC2 evidence bundle today so we can share it after the Wednesday sync.

Jorge — thanks again for the collaboration on this. Our calendar invite for the postmortem sync (Wed 10:00 PT) will be sent shortly.

— Laura
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
